architectural_model.rule: Seven horizontal core layers; the operational foundation is mission-critical but tracked separately; all four vertical threads are intended to touch every layer.

layers.name: Capture & Observation
layers.question: What did the browser actually reveal, when, from which source and with what omissions?
layers.limit: Live capture across real websites/owner Windows environment is not accepted by recent QA evidence.

layers.name: Evidence & Memory
layers.question: What survives faithfully with traceable original evidence, history and integrity?
layers.limit: Derived provenance completeness is not independently revalidated across the full pipeline; a bounded in-memory event window remains for some heuristics.

layers.name: Interpretation & Derivation
layers.question: What are the structural types, field roles and semantic meaning, with warranted confidence?
layers.limit: No reliable cross-session type-alignment/rename integration; historical analysis flags hidden 400-event windows in some paths.

layers.name: Knowledge & Relationships
layers.question: What is the same thing, how does it relate to other things, and why?
capabilities: key and keyless identity within sessions
exact keyed read-through continuity across saved sessions
layers.limit: Keyless cross-session matches deliberately isolated; unchanged keys across renamed inferred types may not link; site scope cannot prove tenant isolation.

layers.name: Learning & Adaptation
layers.question: How do corrections improve future inference without leaking into unrelated scopes?
layers.limit: Suggestion confidence is fed by UI/CLI decisions; complete field-role correction and contamination isolation across sites is not evidenced as wired or independently measured.

layers.name: Behavior & Reconstruction
layers.question: What actions, transitions, histories and reconstructions are justified by the observations?
capabilities: stateAt within session and as-of across saved sessions
layers.limit: No complete process-mining/state-transition engine, temporal retractions or validated bidirectional reconstruction discrepancy loop.

layers.name: Experience & Control
layers.question: Can the user observe, question, correct, replay and control what the system understands?
layers.limit: Full knowledge graph/model explorer, confirmed-identity correction and end-to-end feedback UX are not complete; Core should not expand UI outside critical compatibility changes.

operational_foundation.name: Foundation & Runtime
operational_foundation.principle: Enables every core layer; not counted as product intelligence or core-layer completion.

vertical_threads.name: Identity
vertical_threads.framing_question: What persists as the same entity or object across sources, interpretations, time, views and sessions?
vertical_threads.design_invariant: No unsupported merge; give ambiguous identity its uncertainty and provenance.
vertical_threads.current: exact keyed joins implemented in source, keyless cross-session deliberately isolated, schema drift unresolved

vertical_threads.name: Time & Evidence
vertical_threads.framing_question: When did we observe it, what revision changed, and which immutable evidence supports the claim?
vertical_threads.design_invariant: Unknown timestamp never becomes epoch-zero certainty; gaps and retractions cannot be silently erased.
vertical_threads.current: raw seq/manifest, graph history and cross-session as-of source implemented; validity intervals, deletion semantics, QA retest missing

vertical_threads.name: Semantics
vertical_threads.framing_question: What do fields, entities, actions, relationships and views mean?
vertical_threads.design_invariant: Separate observed structure, semantic inference, hypotheses and user-confirmed knowledge.
vertical_threads.current: role/schema/relationship inference implemented; cross-session semantic field/type alignment remains unwired

vertical_threads.name: Feedback
vertical_threads.framing_question: How do user corrections and observed reconstruction mismatches improve future outcomes?
vertical_threads.design_invariant: Scoped, reversible, transparent learning; avoid contamination and feedback masquerading as proof.
vertical_threads.current: profile accept/reject and confidence calibration paths in source; cross-layer corrective learning and observed-vs-rebuilt discrepancy loop remain incomplete

cross_cutting_invariants: immutable raw evidence; derived state recomputable
absence of observation does not imply deletion
no causal assertion without mechanism evidence

direct_relations.why: correctly understood keys support better entity resolution and relations
reliable evidence makes corrective feedback scoped and reversible
correct sequencing is required for faithful historical behavior
closed-loop aspiration; not an implemented end-to-end feedback loop

leverage_catalog.name: Universal identity
leverage_catalog.purpose: Recognize the same real-world object across DOM, network, sessions, historical changes and replay.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Improves learning, graph consistency, deduplication, timelines and reconstruction.

leverage_catalog.name: Unified observation envelope
leverage_catalog.purpose: Use a common structure for source, time, context, identity candidates, confidence and provenance.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Prevents each downstream subsystem from independently guessing the meaning of raw evidence.

gaps: no evidenced single canonical shared contract across all seven layers

leverage_catalog.name: Temporal continuity
leverage_catalog.purpose: Consistently model changes, revisions, missing observations and event ordering.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Unlocks trustworthy history, learning corrections and replay.

gaps: temporal graph fixes not reaccepted by QA

leverage_catalog.name: Semantic field roles
leverage_catalog.purpose: Identify fields such as ID, timestamp, measure, status, reference or text with calibrated uncertainty.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Better roles improve keys, entity identity, relationships, relevance and reconstructed views.

leverage_catalog.name: Correction propagation
leverage_catalog.purpose: Let one trustworthy correction improve relevant future inference without contaminating unrelated sites or entities.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Creates compounding intelligence across days and sites.

gaps: scoped propagation and contamination tests incomplete
historical entity correction effects not proven

leverage_catalog.name: Provenance & confidence
leverage_catalog.purpose: Trace every derived claim back to evidence and distinguish measured observations from inference.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Enables explainability, correction, reversibility, trustworthy UI and diagnosis.

gaps: complete claim-level trace across every API/view not proven

leverage_catalog.name: Relationship & event correlation
leverage_catalog.purpose: Link DOM, requests, responses, actions and entities with evidence richer than time proximity.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Strengthens behavioral analysis, process discovery, meaning and replay fidelity.

observed_mechanisms: preceded rather than unsupported caused edges

leverage_catalog.name: Structural generalization
leverage_catalog.purpose: Recognize equivalent structures despite changed names, wrappers, layouts or endpoints.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Transfers intelligence to unfamiliar websites and changing versions.

gaps: schemaDiff not used to align known types across recorded sessions

leverage_catalog.name: Reconstruction necessity & relevance
leverage_catalog.purpose: Differentiate what humans need, what machines need, and what faithful replay requires without discarding raw evidence.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Prioritizes analysis, information surfaces and reconstruction effort.

gaps: three-dimensional relevance classifier and calibrated labels not evidenced

leverage_catalog.name: Bidirectional state reconciliation
leverage_catalog.purpose: Compare observed evidence to reconstructed output and feed discrepancies into corrected interpretation.
leverage_catalog.multiplier: Closes the loop: capture → intelligence → replay → discrepancy → learning.

gaps: automated reconstruction comparison and correction propagation not wired

conceptual_sprints.name: Trustworthy Continuity
conceptual_sprints.desired_boundary: An observed object retains justified meaning and identity through evidence, knowledge and history.

conceptual_sprints.name: Continuity Across Sessions
conceptual_sprints.desired_boundary: Safely recognize and trace a keyed entity through separate capture sessions without fabricated merges.

conceptual_sprints.name: Correction & Generalization
conceptual_sprints.desired_boundary: Corrections improve related interpretations across time/sites without contaminating unrelated scopes.

conceptual_sprints.name: Correlation & Behavior
conceptual_sprints.desired_boundary: Observation and action sequences become evidence-backed state transitions.

conceptual_sprints.name: Reconstruction Feedback
conceptual_sprints.desired_boundary: A reconstruction can be compared against evidence and discrepancies explained.

current_status_assessment.summary: The essential capture/evidence pipeline and first within-session intelligence integration are present in source. Cross-session exact keyed continuity, as-of view and presentation exist in source. Most high-multiplier joins across semantics, identity, time, user feedback and reconstruction are only partial. Real-system acceptance remains unverified.
current_status_assessment.code_coverage: targeted static inspection; no full behavioral acceptance and no numerical completion percentages

top_architectural_gaps.name: Type identity drift across sessions
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Conservative joins require stable inferred type IDs; renames and type reclassification create false negatives.

top_architectural_gaps.name: Temporal retractions and validity history
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Revisions and status-history exist, but full deletion/retraction semantics and independent past-state replay remain incomplete.

top_architectural_gaps.name: Model-correction loop
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Calibrator and profile actions are not equivalent to an evidence-backed, scoped field/identity feedback loop.

top_architectural_gaps.name: Provenance and claim uncertainty contract
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Raw and derived evidence pointers exist, but no universally enforced typed observation→claim→render contract is demonstrated.

top_architectural_gaps.name: Observed/reconstructed reconciliation
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Reconciliation helpers exist without an evidenced discrepancy→correction→derivation cycle.

top_architectural_gaps.name: Acceptance and scale
top_architectural_gaps.rationale: Current Sprint 01/02 changes have no post-fix independent QA receipt; cross-session view scans stored revisions, and Windows/live-site acceptance is unproven.

status_vocabulary.substantial_source: large mechanism implemented; not accepted by this document
status_vocabulary.partial_wired_source: some operative code linked, completeness unknown
status_vocabulary.pending_independent_QA: no suitable post-change independent runtime evidence

architecture_guidance.core_instruction: Use the layered cake and multipliers as diagnostic lenses, not mandates or a fixed ordering. Inspect current source, identify system-wide bottlenecks, choose reversible and evidence-preserving improvements, and hand off UI concerns through interfaces.
architecture_guidance.definition_of_vertical_slice: A change whose semantics and provenance remain coherent through at least capture/evidence, interpretation/identity, history and one accessible control surface, without fabricating confidence.
freshness_order: current live code and binding contracts
architecture_guidance.progress_reporting: Use qualitative source/QA statuses and cited commits; do not invent completion percentages or claim that a GitHub commit wakes other agents.
architecture_guidance.deployment_and_safety: Any risky or destructive action is separate from the approval for ordinary safe commits; never overwrite concurrent main work.
